aggressive_definition: Incident prostate cancers labeled aggressive; the abstract does not provide stage, grade, or other criteria defining aggressive disease.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: 732 incident prostate cancers were identified through the local population cancer registry, including 132 aggressive cases and 53 prostate cancer deaths.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: In a prospective cohort of 16,872 men aged 27-70 years at recruitment and followed-up from 1994 to the end of 2003, 732 incident prostate cancers were identified through the local population cancer registry, including 132 aggressive cases and 53 prostate cancer deaths.
reason: The prospective cohort abstract analyzes overall incident prostate cancer and separately analyzes incident aggressive and nonaggressive prostate cancers. Prostate cancer mortality is also reported but is distinct from the aggressive incidence endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Compared to abstainers, men consuming 1-19 g/d of alcohol had a slightly reduced incidence of aggressive prostate cancers (hazard ratio 0.67; 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.43, 1.06) and prostate cancer mortality (hazard ratio 0.56; 95% CI 0.28, 1.14), but their risk of nonaggressive prostate cancers was close to unity (hazard ratio 1.09; 95% CI 0.85, 1.40).
estimate_classifications.reason: The row's HR of 0.67 compares alcohol intake of 1-19 g/day with abstention for incident aggressive prostate cancer.
